# H tell them first

> The customer should hear about the escalation from us, with a name and a next-contact time, before an unfamiliar name appears on their ticket.


## The heuristic

**The customer should hear about the escalation from us, with a name and a next-contact time, before an unfamiliar name appears on their ticket.**


_Why:_ An unannounced new responder reads as being passed around, which is precisely the experience escalation exists to end. The same event framed as "I have brought in X, who now owns this" reads as being taken seriously.
